title: Socket, which helps companies safeguard open-source code against hackers, raised $60M led by Thrive Capital at a $1B valuation (Dina Bass/Bloomberg)
summary: Dina Bass / Bloomberg: Socket, which helps companies safeguard open-source code against hackers, raised $60M led by Thrive Capital at a $1B valuation — Socket, a cybersecurity startup that sells technology to help safeguard open-source code against hackers, has raised a new round of funding that values the company at $1 billion.
